body:
About me: Have tried various stimulants, benzos, ketamine, LSD in various doses, 2C-B several times, and various prescribed drugs. Used to be sensitive to drugs but not as much anymore.
A regular boring saturday afternoon I wanted to take my last remaining 2C-B, expecting it to be enough for a good trip, only to find out it was about 7mg when weighing it. Having read that moclobemide/Aurorix could potentiate it, I decided to try, since I had a few pills of that left over after I had them prescribed.
At about 5pm I put my 7mg in a capsule and swallowed, and cleaned the plastic bag it had been in in a glass of water to get the last of it out. I would estimate that to 1mg max, so 8mg in total. I also swallowed 75mg of moclobemide, and sat down and had dinner to distract myself before the effects came on.
After about 30-45minutes I noticed I had experienced a kind of tunnel vision for about 10 minutes, so I went to bed and listened to music under the covers during the come up, and then stayed there for most of the trip.
The whole trip was very smooth and nice, but shorter than a usual 2C-B trip. It did feel like a full trip, albeit a comparatively mild one.
I did not get the usual tension as with only 2C-B and it felt in general less amphetamine-like, and the body load was less intense. I felt somewhat clearer in my mind also compared to 2C-B without moclobemide.
The effects that were not unique to this combo but still evidence of the potentiation were that I had full blown visuals at the peak during the second hour, and for a brief moment went into level 8A geometry. I was also very "in" my body and danced while lying on my back, exploring my body that way. While I listened to a song I love I had a very cathartic experience of mixed crying and laughing from it.
At around 8 or 9pm I had no visuals, only a weird but nice feeling in my body. Went for a walk where I noticed colors more than usual, and was a bit clearer in my ability to hold concepts in my mind, other than that I was basically sober.
I think this combination to potentiate 2C-B is very good with a small dose of 2C-B. I will probably use this method for when I want less body load, a shorter trip, when I'm feeling cheap, and when I don't have much left. I would advise care for others to try this though, since people online have reported unpredictable potentiation.
